title: Existence of a computing tree with a depth
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega)\to\alpha$. There exist a natural number $d$ and a decision tree that computes $f$ and has depth $d$.
